title: Description: BIG-IP iControl REST tokens may not expire as expected in all scenarios. (CVE-2026-120718)
description: BIG-IP iControl REST tokens may not expire as expected in all scenarios, allowing an attacker who has obtained a token to potentially extend its expiry lifetime unless the token owner deletes it. This issue affects the control plane only and does not expose the data plane. Versions that have reached End of Technical Support are not evaluated.
